# Princeton University <span class='zh-inline'>(普林斯顿大学)</span>

<img src="logos/princeton.svg" alt="Princeton University identifier" width="150" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1.4rem 0">

The fourth-oldest US college, where Turing studied and lambda calculus was born — the theoretical root of functional programming.

> 美国第四古老的高等院校，图灵曾在此求学，λ 演算在此诞生——函数式编程的理论根源。

## Background (背景)

Chartered in 1746 as the College of New Jersey, Princeton is the fourth-oldest college in the United States; it was renamed Princeton University in 1896.

> 1746 年以“新泽西学院”之名获特许成立，是美国第四古老的高等院校，1896 年更名为普林斯顿大学。

## Notable people (名人)

**Alan Turing** — earned a mathematics PhD in 1938 with a dissertation on ordinal logic, advised by Alonzo Church. **Alonzo Church** — Princeton faculty 1929–67, creator of lambda calculus. **Robert Tarjan** — professor since 1985 and 1986 Turing Award recipient for algorithms and data structures.

> **Alan Turing** — 1938 年获数学博士学位，论文研究序数逻辑，导师为 Alonzo Church。**Alonzo Church** — 1929–67 年任教于普林斯顿，创立 λ 演算。**Robert Tarjan** — 1985 年起任教授，因算法与数据结构获 1986 年图灵奖。

## Notable CS courses (著名计算机课程)

COS 126 Computer Science: An Interdisciplinary Approach · COS 217 Programming Systems · COS 226 Algorithms and Data Structures · COS 418 Distributed Systems · COS 423 Theory of Algorithms.

> COS 126 计算机科学跨学科导论 · COS 217 编程系统 · COS 226 算法与数据结构 · COS 418 分布式系统 · COS 423 算法理论。
